purpose: Explain material uncertainty in an approved property answer precisely, including what is known, what remains unresolved, why it matters, what evidence or legal source could resolve it, and what can still safely be concluded.
core_principle: KNOWN → UNCERTAIN → WHY IT MATTERS → WHAT COULD RESOLVE IT → SAFE CONCLUSION
rules: Uncertainty is stated specifically rather than as a generic confidence statement.
Only material unresolved items are displayed as answer limitations.
A missing record is not treated as proof that an event did not occur.
Access restriction is distinguished from record absence.
Retrieval failure is distinguished from evidence of non-existence.
Conflicting sources are identified as conflicts until resolved.
Uncertainty about one property interest does not automatically make unrelated interests uncertain.
The minimum resolving evidence or legal source is identified where known.
A safe partial conclusion may be provided when supported.
hard_stops: Never hide a material unresolved dependency.
Never convert uncertainty into a probability or invented confidence score.
Never claim absence from a failed retrieval.
Never treat access restriction as non-existence.
Never state a definitive conclusion beyond the verified evidence.
Never expose restricted or unnecessary personal data.
